title: AquaTerra in January 2025: {count} drives, starting with dogs
description: January 2025 at AquaTerra: {count} drives, opening with dog feeding on 4 January, then art sessions at Pather Sathi and women's workshops.
lede: In January 2025 AquaTerra ran {count} drives across {placesCount} places, with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts. The month opened with dog feeding drives at Salt Lake, Bangur and Howrah on the same day, 4 January. It then moved into art sessions for children at Pather Sathi and women's empowerment workshops at Tetultala Ashram and Amader Pradakhep.

sections.heading: dogs first, all on one day
body: The series opened on 4 January with Tails and Treats drives at Bangur, Howrah and Salt Lake. Drive 25.0 was at Bangur, Drive 26.0 at Howrah and Drive 27.0 at Salt Lake, all on the same day. The Bangur drive notes 40 dogs fed, the Howrah drive 45, and the Salt Lake drive 30.

Small teams are normal for these drives. The Salt Lake drive had the smallest team of the month, and it still fed the dogs it went out to feed. The [Tails and Treats](/impact/tails-and-treats) page follows the whole series across the years.

sections.heading: art sessions at pather sathi
body: Pather Sathi hosted the month's art sessions. Brush Time on 11 January had children explore colour through drawing and painting. Art Hour on 18 January had painting and craft activities that nurtured imagination and creative confidence.
Repeating an art session at the same place within a month gave the children a second chance at the same kind of work.

sections.heading: women's empowerment workshops
body: Women's workshops ran in the second half of the month. Power Within at Tetultala Ashram on 22 January held sessions on self-worth, rights and skills. Her Voice at [Amader Pradakhep](/impact/amader-pradakhep) on 24 January offered talks on rights and confidence-building, with skill-sharing activities.
Both workshops mixed talks with activities, so people could practise what they heard rather than only listen. That mix is a good model for any session on rights or confidence.

learnings: Running several dog drives on one day spreads the work across neighbourhoods, from Salt Lake to Howrah.
A talk paired with a skill-sharing activity gives people something to practise straight away.
Repeating an art format at the same place within a month shows a session that works and can be planned again.

faqs.q: What did AquaTerra do in January 2025?
faqs.a: AquaTerra ran {count} drives in January 2025, with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts across {placesCount} places. The month opened with dog feeding drives on 4 January, then art sessions at Pather Sathi and women's empowerment workshops at Tetultala Ashram and Amader Pradakhep.

faqs.q: Where did AquaTerra feed stray dogs on 4 January 2025?
faqs.a: AquaTerra fed stray dogs at Bangur, Howrah and Salt Lake on 4 January 2025, as part of the Tails and Treats series. The Bangur drive notes 40 dogs fed and the Howrah drive 45.

faqs.q: What women's workshops did AquaTerra hold in January 2025?
faqs.a: AquaTerra ran Power Within at Tetultala Ashram on 22 January and Her Voice at Amader Pradakhep on 24 January 2025. Both covered rights, confidence and skills through talks and activities.

faqs.q: Does AquaTerra run art workshops for children in Kolkata?
faqs.a: Yes. In January 2025 children painted and drew at Pather Sathi in Brush Time on 11 January and Art Hour on 18 January. AquaTerra's student volunteers run them, and you can join to help.
